messages:
zoe: Pushed a small PR to rework SOC2 audit log retention wording and add SDK snippets for export + redaction. Need legal sign-off on phrasing for tenant TTL and a quick link fix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
kevin: skimmed it — overall good. quick q: are we saying the retention TTL is a per-tenant default or per-export? current sentence is ambiguous. :thinking:
zoe: intent was 'storage TTL applies to stored audit logs; exports and legal holds can extend retention'. suggested rewrite: 'Audit logs are retained per-tenant according to the configured TTL. Legal holds and export requests may suspend deletion and extend retention.'
samir: I like that. prefer 'suspend deletion' vs 'override' (legal will like it). also we should call out who can request exports (org admin / compliance roles).
legal-sr: agree on wording. also please don't use 'override' or 'permanent' without definition. add link to our retention policy internal doc: https://internal/legal/retention. and add a one-line example of a legal hold workflow.
zoe: adding a sentence and a short example. also including Ruby + Go SDK snippets for export + redaction. snippets below:
```ruby
# Ruby example
client.export_audit_logs( tenant_id: 'acme', start: '2024-01-01', end: '2024-06-30', redact_pii: true )
```
```go
// Go example
req := &ExportRequest{TenantID: "acme", Start: "2024-01-01", End: "2024-06-30", RedactPII: true}
client.ExportAuditLogs(ctx, req)
```
kevin: small nit: Ruby examples in the repo usually use symbol keys or keyword args. your snippet is fine, just keep it consistent with other docs. maybe `redact_pii:` is preferable since other examples show snake_case.
zoe: good call — switched to snake_case for Ruby params. updated PR.
sam: for the migration guide: should we include a mapping table for legacy audit schema to new structured events (e.g., user.email -> actor.email)? some customers asked about field name changes.
zoe: yes adding a 3-row table + JSON example mapping. will put it under /docs/migration/audit-schema.md and link from the main page.
legal-sr: one more ask: add explicit line about RBAC for exports and retention changes: 'Only org admins and users with the Compliance role can request exports or change TTLs.' That helps auditors.
zoe: adding RBAC sentence and a short example command showing the CLI export with `--redact` flag and `--requester-role` note. also fixed a 404 link in the CLI section (changed /docs/cli/export to /docs/cli#export-audit).
kevin: thanks — leaving review comments on a couple of phrasing spots.
docs-bot: PR 482 updated, link-checker passed, staging build succeeded.
zoe: merging tomorrow morning if no objections. thanks all :thumbsup:
